gaps.why: Fiserv's releases and slides for 2025-Q2 through 2026-Q2 give Clover revenue only as growth rates; the dollar amount appears only for FY2025 ($3.3 billion). Transcript summaries quoting quarterly dollars are third-party and were not used.

Fiserv states Clover GPV only as an annualized run rate of the quarter, not a quarterly total; annualized rows are recorded as stated_run_rate. Run-rate values for 2024-Q3 to 2025-Q1 were not read in this pass (earlier decks).
Quarterly earnings releases for 2025-Q3 through 2026-Q2 disclose no dollar payment volume, only 'trillions in payments volume' and segment volume growth rates on calls.
Only the first-half 2025 total (computed from the Q3 2025 release) was read; the Q1 and Q2 2025 releases were not opened in this pass. 2026 segments were recast and are not comparable.
Block's headline segment measure is gross profit, not net revenue; Square and Cash App rows are gross profit by design.
